function: Q-learning selects the beampattern peak angle to track a moving target under SINR and geofencing constraints; GPR infers the target AoA under beam misalignment (pp. 8-10).
system: DFRC base station with 16 antennas, two single-antenna users, one moving target; ZF beamforming; 6 GHz, 1 MHz bandwidth; no RIS (pp. 4, 11).
method: Q-learning with a Q-table (state: target position; action: beam angle; sigmoid soft-penalty reward), offline training; Gaussian process regression for AoA; ZF beamforming fixed (pp. 8-11).
data_channel: Simulated steering-vector LoS channels with estimation error; two fixed users; target moving at 3 and 2 m/s with random directions; no dataset (pp. 6, 11).
test_conditions: Trained for 5000 episodes on random target trajectories; tested on different trajectories with the same users, array, carrier and thresholds (p. 11).
baselines: Non-learning B1 (gradient-based beam selection, sum-log-SINR) and B2 (exhaustive search, sensing gain), both constrained; unconstrained Q-learning (variant) (pp. 12-14).
metrics: SINR per user, angular separation to users, secrecy rate and Shannon capacity against the target, policy plots, GPR regression surface (pp. 11-15).
complexity: Training O(E*tau_train*(M+2K)); testing O(Ntest*Nangles*(M+2K)), stated lower than benchmarks B1 and B2 (pp. 9, 14).
q1_support: p. 6: "hk is formulated as hk = βk a†ϕAoD,k , where βk denotes the" - custom steering-vector LoS channel with estimation error (p. 5); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "target are entirely different from those used during training." - only target trajectories change; users, array, carrier and thresholds stay fixed (p. 11), a held-out part of the same scenario.
q3_support: p. 13: "we compare it with two classical baseline methods, namely" - B1 and B2 are non-learning; no earlier learned method is compared (unconstrained Q-learning, p. 12, is a variant of the proposed method).
q4_support: p. 9: "O(2K) complexity. Thus, the overall training complexity is" - O(E tau_train (M+2K)); testing order and comparison with B1 and B2 on p. 14.
q5_support: p. 11: "carrier frequency is fcarrier = 6 GHz, the bandwidth is" - simulated setup; no code or data link, no public dataset.
notes: Area 5: the learned Q-learning module picks the radar beam angle of a DFRC beampattern under SINR and geofencing constraints, and GPR infers the AoA; ZF beamforming, covariance design and power coefficients are non-learned (pp. 5-6). q2 is 0 because only target trajectories differ between training and testing. q3 is 0 because the only learned comparison is an unconstrained variant of the proposed Q-learning.
